newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - plenty of Russian around.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - plenty of Russian around.

text.p: Russian straight run was well offered on Monday with at least three E-4 cargoes available.
One high water E-4 was understood sold at formula -$2.
"There does not appear to be any shortage of straight run and E-4 has come under some pressure," said a dealer who pegged less high water cargoes at flat formula.
An M-40 was also available while M-100 straight run was assessed at two means +$2.
Low sulphur straight run was steady to a touch firmer trying to keep pace with later day stronger crude. A cargo was heard offered around $145 fob NWE. +44 171 542 8980
